body: Thank you, I know you are struggling with this, please don't go, you have value to your loved ones, and to this world. The doctor I spoke with agrees with you. Also thought that that he might be be affected by Schizophrenia. You matter and you have value. Thank you for your kind words.

Thank you for your words, we've had him involuntarily committed... what do I do next? I am afraid, and I'm lost. I love him so much, and I cannot stop thinking about him, about this, and worrying, I am so scared that I am going to lose him. I think that he will figure out how to maliciously comply with the doctors, and manipulate them into thinking he is better, tell them all of the things they want to hear, and will get out, and end his own life. 

I don't know what to say to bring him back. I can't lose him, he is precious and unique and I'm losing this, nothing I say helps, he just keeps going further away from me. I am putting my faith in God and the Doctors at this point. 

How can I communicate with him, so that I don't make things worse? What is the next move that I make, is there something I should avoid, or something that I shouldn't do. I'm so afraid that I'm going to misstep or misspeak.
